{{Top|leg}}
A '''loommaster''' or '''loommistress''' was a particularly adept [[Weaver (Askajian)|weaver]] within [[Askajian/Legends|Askajian]] society. They were high regarded by Askajians, and were considered to be a great asset to the tribe due to their exceptional skill in weaving [[tomuon cloth]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
